thread:
devon: FYI bumped @redwood/sdk to 0.8.0 and onboarding samples started failing in CI (Node 14 + Jest). Repro: `require('@redwood/sdk')` yields undefined.default.

anya: Hmm, did we remove the CJS fallback in package.json exports? Edge runtimes also complain about missing default in MJS.

kevin: Yep, cleaned up main/module/exports to be ESM-first and removed legacy cjs path. That broke consumers expecting a default export.

devon: Error in worker emulation: `The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/esm/index.js' does not provide an export named "default"`.

anya: Quick options: add a `exports."."` CJS fallback, and add a tiny cjs wrapper that sets `module.exports = require('../dist/esm').default || require('../dist/esm')`. Also update types to include `export default` for DX.

kevin: I'll open a patch PR and publish a canary. Also add a CI smoke step to run `node -e \"console.log(require('@redwood/sdk'))\"` against the published package before final release.

docs-bot: Note: update onboarding README to show `import * as Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` and `import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk'` examples, plus a note on Node<12 CJS quirks.

ci-bot: Canary published: @redwood/sdk@0.8.1-canary.0.

devon: Testing canary now in onboarding sample (worker and jest)  initial smoke looks good.

kevin: PR #4102 created. Will include changelog, migration note, and automated sample test for worker emulation.

anya: Thanks, team. Once tests pass, cut patch and backport docs to Dedicated onboarding.
